name: smwgraphics-actraiser-kasandora-act
title: ActRaiser - Kasandora (Act 1)
description:
The backgrounds seen in the desertic of Kasandora, from ActRaiser.

There's two versions of the background, which are seen on different parts of the level in the original game. They should be easy to adjust vertically, as well.

The first half uses palette row 3, but only has desert dunes and clouds.

Meanwhile, the second half uses palette rows 0 and 3, but has desert dunes, a big abyss and clouds. More GFX space is used, though.

Pick the one you like more.

A good fit for deserts, in general.
